White text on a pale grey gradient fades into it.

Grey text on a grey box drawn by a pseudo-element.

White text that runs from a black half onto a white half of the box behind it.

Small light text in a thin weight, a little too pale for its size on white.

Black text made faint with opacity.

Dark text on a light picture is easy to read.

White text on a deep blue gradient.

Small thin dark grey text on white has enough contrast.

Black text at three quarters opacity on white.
